title: Пикар на Rust: Онгудай, замеры по потокам, README «Rust vs эталон»
goal: Онгудай 400 м на Rust против эталона AM-01 f64 и GPU игры: итерации, невязка по итерациям, отклонение поля, время (мс/итерацию, нс на клетку, 1/4/8/16 потоков, решение, пара, штиль); README с таблицей «Rust vs эталон», командами воспроизведения и выводом о жизнеспособности по числам.
scope: tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/ — крейт picard_rs (кроме contract/): src/, out/, README.md, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs

accept.name: clippy
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu AC-R3 --no-tmux -- cargo clippy --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings

accept.name: blocks_dev
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu AC-R3 --no-tmux -- cargo run -q --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml -- blocks tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/flat_wind.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/agnesi.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/heated_slope.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/saddle.json

accept.name: solve_ref_release
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu AC-R3 --no-tmux -- bash -c 'set -e; for c in flat_wind agnesi heated_slope saddle; do tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/$c.json --threads 8 --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_${c}_release_t8.json; done' && python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/tolerance.py tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_flat_wind_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_agnesi_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_heated_slope_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_saddle_release_t8.json

accept.name: solve_ongudai_release
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu AC-R3 --no-tmux -- bash -c 'set -e; for c in ongudai_d400_u3_heat ongudai_d400_u3_mech ongudai_d400_u0_heat ongudai_d400_u6_heat; do tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve ~/data/air_cascade/ongudai/$c.json --threads 8 --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_${c}_release_t8.json; done' && python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/tolerance.py --iters-tol 20 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u3_heat_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u3_mech_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u0_heat_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u6_heat_release_t8.json
